requirement: Clients in 10.0.1.0/24 must be able to reach the web server network 10.0.2.0/24, and access from clients to the management network 10.0.99.0/24 must be blocked on r1.

proposal.rationale: To allow clients in 10.0.1.0/24 to reach the web server network 10.0.2.0/24, a static route needs to be configured on r1 pointing to the next hop as 10.0.12.2. Additionally, to block access from clients to the management network 10.0.99.0/24 on r1, an access control rule should be added.
